name: Love:Quiz ~Koi Suru Otome no Final Answer~
original_name: LOVE:QUIZ ~恋する乙女のファイナルアンサー~
source:
One invitation changes your life.
You are participating in a quiz game 'Love:Quiz" where you bet your love.
If you win in the game you earn a 'Fated Lover', if you fail it's game over...
Your choices of a partner are all very individual people, including a judge and an idol.
While taking on the game with your partner love will sprout.
Will you be able to obtain the prize of a 'Fated Lover'?

[Translated from [url=http://www37.atwiki.jp/girlgame/pages/3296.html]Girl Game Wiki[/url]]
translation:
一次邀请改变了你的人生。
你参加了一场名为“Love:Quiz”的竞猜游戏，用自己的爱情下注。
赢得游戏，就能获得“命中注定的恋人”；失败，游戏结束……
可选择的搭档都是个性十足的人，包括评委和偶像。
与搭档一起挑战游戏时，爱情会悄然萌芽。
你能获得“命中注定的恋人”这一奖品吗？

[译自[url=http://www37.atwiki.jp/girlgame/pages/3296.html]Girl Game Wiki[/url]]
